isInstrumental.question:
Hello! 👋 I'm the AI that will create your personalized music.

First, choose your music format carefully:

🎤 **Sung** — has lyrics and a voice singing (great for tributes, dedications, birthdays)
📝 **I have the lyrics** — paste your lyrics and the AI sings them
🎹 **Instrumental** — ONLY instruments, NO lyrics, NO voice, NO singing
isInstrumental.sungDesc: With lyrics and a singing voice — best for tributes and messages
isInstrumental.customLyricDesc: Paste your own lyrics and the AI sings them
isInstrumental.instrumentalDesc: ⚠️ Instruments only. NO lyrics, NO voice, NO singing
isInstrumental.confirmInstrumentalTitle: Are you sure you want Instrumental?
isInstrumental.confirmInstrumentalBody:
You picked Instrumental. Your music will have ONLY instruments playing — no lyrics, no voice and nobody singing.

If you want to honor, congratulate or tell someone a story, we recommend 🎤 Sung Song.

📢 Type your ad/voiceover text 🎙️
